title: Publish a durable federation link within the exact image-confirmation lock
outcome: Avoid a fail-closed reconnect retry when an unrelated federation mutation starts after exact durability confirmation but before the runtime link UUID publication.
acceptance: A successful exact-image federation connection confirmation and runtime UUID publication occur under one state-lock cut without IO under that lock.

A controlled concurrent mutation regression demonstrates that publication cannot be lost in the former second-lock gap; stale basis still refuses and admission/reservations/quarantine semantics remain unchanged.
